name: web3-tx-status-read
note: FP-trap for the on-chain heuristic: a legitimate wallet/explorer helper that reads a transaction by hash (eth_getTransactionByHash / provider.getTransaction) to report its confirmation status. It reads chain state but never extracts raw calldata to decode and never feeds anything to an interpreter — so it must NOT trip onchain-c2-loader. Proves the EtherHiding signal requires a co-located executor (or a raw calldata-extraction step), not merely touching a chain-read RPC that real web3 libraries use constantly.
